cues: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet, on demand, and you pay only for what you use.
The provider owns and maintains the hardware; you rent capacity.
The official NIST definition lists five characteristics: self service on demand, access over the network, pooled resources shared by many customers, elasticity, and metered pay per use.
text: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet, on demand, and you pay only for what you use. The provider owns and maintains the hardware; you rent capacity. The official NIST definition lists five characteristics: self service on demand, access over the network, pooled resources shared by many customers, elasticity, and metered pay per use. The trick underneath is virtualisation.
